# Check current path extent

# Look at rows 38-39 to see the full path

    line = ascii_lines[r]
    # Find where the path pattern starts and ends
    path_chars = set('wgW')
    start = None
    end = None
    for c, ch in enumerate(line):
        if ch in path_chars:
            if start is None:

after = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
changes = []
for r in range(64):
    for c in range(64):
        if r < len(before) and c < len(before[r]) and r < len(after) and c < len(after[r]):
            if before[r][c] != after[r][c]:
                changes.append((r, c, before[r][c], after[r][c]))
print(f"Cells changed: {len(changes)}")
for r, c, bef, aft in changes[:20]:
    print(f"  ({r},{c}): '{bef}' -> '{aft}'")
